title: Detection of small intestinal IgA+TNFα+iNOS+ CELLS by Immunofluorescence Microscopy \(IF)
protocol: Cut the small intestines out of animals and remove the mesentery and fat.
Gently push out the fecal content using a forceps.
Wash the small intestines gently twice in PBS.
Cut open the intestines longitudinally and into small pieces, approximately 1 cm each.
Place tissue sections in base molds.
Cover tissue sections with OCT compound.
Freeze the OCT-tissue blocks in dry-ice-chilled 2-methyl-butane.
Wrap frozen OCT-tissue blocks in aluminum paper.
Store wrapped blocks at -80°C until used for sectioning.
Cut intestinal tissue sections at 5 μm using a Leica CM3050 cryostat.
Mount the sections on glass microscope slides.
Fix the sections for seven minutes in ice-cold acetone.
Air-dry the fixed sections for one hour at room temperature.
Store fixed sections at -80°C in desiccant bags.
Rehydrate sections in TBS for 20 minutes.
Place sections in TBS-T for an additional 20 minutes by gentle shaking.

Block unspecific binding of antibodies by incubating tissue sections in TBS-T supplemented with 10% normal rabbit serum, 10% normal mouse serum, 5% sterile-filtered BSA, and 2 mg/ml of a rat anti-mouse CD16/CD32 antibody for 30 minutes in a humidified chamber.
Remove the blocking solution and dip the slides briefly in TBS-T.
Apply mixtures of fluorochrome-labeled antibodies diluted in TBS-T to the slides for 45 minutes in the dark in a humidified chamber.
Remove the staining solutions and wash the slides three times for ten minutes each in TBS-T, once with TBS, and once with PBS in slide-beakers with gentle shaking.
Stain the slides with DAPI nucleic acid stain for 30 seconds.
Wash the slides three times with PBS in slide-beakers with gentle shaking.
Mount the slides with Gel/Mount medium using coverslips.

Acquire images with a Leica DMRA2 fluorescence microscope equipped with a Retiga EXi digital camera and OpenLab software, keeping picture acquisition settings and exposure times constant for every fluorescent channel when comparing tissues of diverse genotypes.
Process images utilizing Photoshop CS5, applying adjustments to input and output levels in an equal manner for all compared images.
Count the numbers of small intestinal LP IgA+ plasma cells and CD8α+ cells in a blinded fashion using ImageJ.
Analyse and quantify a total of five separate images from sections of six mice per group.
